info.name: Traces Safety Full Flow
info.description: End-to-end Safety system tests for normal users and admins. Covers user incident reporting, public visibility, community validation, admin moderation, dangerous locations, checkpoint reports, SOS, OCHA logs/manual import, and dashboard stats. Login first, then set userToken and adminToken collection variables.

item.name: A. Auth Setup / Instructions
item.description: Use these requests if your local auth setup is configured. Otherwise log in through the app and paste tokens into collection variables userToken and adminToken.

request.description: Run this after setting baseUrl. Then log in as a normal user and as an admin, and paste JWTs into userToken and adminToken. All user requests use Authorization: Bearer {{userToken}}. All admin requests use Authorization: Bearer {{adminToken}}.
Optional. Replace credentials with a real normal user. Saves token to userToken when login succeeds.
Optional. Replace credentials with a real admin user. Saves token to adminToken when login succeeds.
